title: Inert-active orthogonal factorization in a symmetric infinity-operad
statement:
Use quasicategories, coherent functors and mapping spaces of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and symmetric infinity-operads, inert edges and active edges as defined in [lem-coef-operadic-approximation-restriction]. Let $P\to N(\mathsf{Fin}_*)$ be any symmetric infinity-operad in a fixed universe. Every edge $h:x\to z$ admits a coherent factorization $x\xrightarrow{i}y\xrightarrow{a}z$ with $i$ inert and $a$ active. Both classes contain the equivalences, are closed under composition, and are invariant under equivalence of arrows. For every inert $i:x\to y$ and active $a:u\to v$, the canonical map
$$\operatorname{Map}_P(y,u)\longrightarrow\operatorname{Map}_P(x,u)\mathop{\times}^{h}_{\operatorname{Map}_P(x,v)}\operatorname{Map}_P(y,v),\qquad t\longmapsto(ti,at),$$
is an equivalence. The homotopy pullback uses postcomposition with $a$ and precomposition with $i$. Here $X\times_Z^hY$ is the space of triples $(x,y,\gamma)$, with $\gamma$ a path between the two images in $Z$, retaining all paths and higher simplices; explicitly it is $X\times_{Z,\operatorname{ev}_0}\operatorname{Fun}(\Delta^1,Z)\times_{\operatorname{ev}_1,Z}Y$. Equivalently, the space of fillers, including both triangular homotopies, of every coherent square with left side $i$ and right side $a$ is contractible. All arities, including zero and nullary active operations, are allowed.
